articles.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a US election
articles.description: The Chicago-born pontiff, who has a tense relationship with Trump, mailed in a ballot for the midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.

articles.title: Democratic senator blames Egypt press crackdown on US military aid decision
articles.description: Chris Murphy said waiving a human rights condition on aid paved the way for arrests of journalists.

articles.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
articles.description: End of subsidies and rising prices drive discontent, testing support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's government.

articles.title: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia
articles.description: Days after ousting Aleksandar Vučić's party from power, Student List MPs call for top figures to stand down.

articles.title: Banished: The Taliban's War On Women - tickets go live for Sky News documentary screening
articles.description: Tickets are now on sale for a screening, followed by a Q&A, of Alex Crawford's new documentary, Banished: The Taliban's War On Women.

articles.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off east coast as tensions with South rise
articles.description: North Korea has launched ballistic missiles off its east coast into the Sea of Japan, South Korea said on Thursday, as tensions continued to rise between the two countries.
